newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish crude imports seen up to 16.8 mln T in 2000.
newsitem.headline: Polish crude imports seen up to 16.8 mln T in 2000.

text.p: Polish crude imports are likely to rise to 16.8 million tonnes in the year 2000 from an estimated 15 million in 1996, ING Barings said in its February report on Central European Oil and Gas.
It said total Polish oil consumption was likely to rise to 17.1 million tonnes in 2000 from an estimated 15.3 million in 1996.

The report said total Polish refining capacity would stay flat at 17.5 million tonnes a year or 352 barrels per day, but the utilisation of that capacity was seen rising to 97.6 percent in 2000 from an estimated 87.3 percent in 1996.
The report was prepared before Poland freed all fuel prices in early February.
